PM Surya Ghar Scheme Surpasses 50 Lakh Household Installations

The PM Surya Ghar Scheme has now installed solar rooftop systems in over 50 lakh households across India. In July alone, a record 5.06 lakh installations were added. The scheme offers beneficiaries up to 300 units of free electricity and a subsidy of ₹78,000.
